ai_quote: Its software scans public records, including federal court filings, and uses AI to analyze the allegations and prepare research for its partner law firms.

company.description: Chariot Claims works with law firms to identify potential consumer legal cases, find affected consumers and gather information needed to pursue compensation for claims over alleged privacy violations, hidden fees and hard-to-cancel subscriptions.
